business_sentence.title: ACME Q2 2026 Earnings Call
business_sentence.body:
Operator: Good afternoon, and welcome to the ACME second quarter 2026 earnings conference call.

Advertising revenue grew 20% and advertisement pricing declined.

Management described the commercial rollout, customer qualification, capacity expansion and overseas launch schedule in detail.

Revenue for the quarter was 1.2 billion dollars, up 12 percent year over year.

short_title.title: ACME Q2 2026 Earnings Call
short_title.body:
Q&A

Operator: We will now open the line for questions. Please go ahead.

Analyst: Thank you. Can you talk about the advertising pricing trend in the quarter?

CEO: Sure. Advertising revenue growth was 20 points and pricing stabilized, which is what we expected given the mix shift.

CFO: We remain confident in our full year outlook and the guidance ranges we published in May.
